main.description: One latte (or other espresso drink) review, written by the drinker. A person's log is every review record in their own repo, newest first — see public/lib/log.js. Written and read by cremalog (https://cremalog.bisks.net).

drink.description: What was ordered, e.g. "banana bread matcha latte".

rating.description: Rating out of 10, stored ×10 for one decimal place of precision (e.g. 75 = 7.5/10).

reviewedAt.description: When this latte was had, as an ISO 8601 datetime.
